summary: chats stream renders SSE events live from PostStream's body reader (previously buffered via io.ReadAll), carries the event: type across lines within an SSE block (previously lost, every event rendered as data), and exits non-zero on SSE error events.
reason: Greptile review P1 on chats_stream.go: buffered SSE + lost event types + silent success on error events made the streaming command misleading for agents and scripts.
